faqs.a:
The city has established an employee committee for the purpose of enhancing communication
               for both the city manager and the city employees. Representatives to the employee
               committee are selected by each department. Representatives may meet monthly with the
               city manager or their designee. The city manager may periodically discuss with the
               employee committee any employee issues which the city manager deems necessary to discuss
               with the committee. Employee committee members may use this meeting time to discuss
               any issues or employee concerns with the city manager or their designee. Representation
               on the committee will be established by the bylaws of the committee. The employee
               committee may collect and expend funds for sanctioned activities and events related
               to employee recognition, activities that benefit employees, or community service.
(
Ord. No. 4862
, § 1, 10-16-2023)
